note: Lake County TN publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (Lake_Co_Zoning.pdf). No ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable GIS zoning layer found in county, state (TNMap, Tennessee Property Viewer) or ArcGIS Online searches. Tiptonville and Ridgely publish no zoning GIS layer either; the county's assessor points only to the state parcel viewer, which has no zoning districts.
